Welcome to Talbot Primary School
We are a busy but friendly school, with lots going on. This website aims to give you a taster of the school, as well as providing up to date information for parents, pupils and the wider community.
We hope that you enjoy your visit to our website, and that you find the information you are looking for. Please feel free to contact the school direct with any queries you may have.

The school has fantastic facilities, including a self-contained band room and purpose-built sports changing rooms. There has been a strong emphasis on both music and sport at Talbot since the school opened, with many superb musical productions being staged over the years and talented sports people.
There are over five acres of playing field space, to be utilised for both sports and outdoor learning, alongside a large playground and tennis courts. It is also close to Talbot Heath; an urban heath that is home to a variety of rare wildlife.

Wraparound Care (Breakfast and After School Club)
Talbot Stars Information
‘Talbot Stars’ is Talbot Primary Schools provision for before and after school childcare. The club is based in the school bungalow where we have well equipped rooms which cater for both the Breakfast and After School Club. Talbot Stars Breakfast and After School Club have been running successfully for a number of years and are run by our own experienced and dedicated staff members.
When you arrive at the bungalow entrance, please wait for a member of staff to sign in your child.
Breakfast Club runs from 7.30am until 8.30am and includes breakfast (cereal or toast) and a drink. The charge is £4.50 per session.
After School Club runs from 3.10pm until 5.45pm and includes a light snack and drink. The charge is £10.00 per session.
Any collections after 5.45pm will incur a late collection charge of £10 every 15 minutes.
Please note: sessions must be booked via the My Child at School (MCAS) app and must be paid for in advance of attending. Childcare voucher schemes are accepted by the school, please contact the School Business Manager to set up this facility. Bookings in advance can be made weekly, monthly or half-termly but all bookings must be prepaid.
Due to safeguarding a parent/carer must sign their child in or out of this provision.
When booking, please ensure you carefully read the
Talbot Stars Terms & Conditions below.
TERMS AND CONDITIONS
Breakfast and After School Club Telephone Number: 01202 513981 option 6
(only available during club working hours).
If you have any questions about the above clubs, do not hesitate to contact the school office for more information. Our Admin Team are always on hand to help.
